RobotsEnabled.description: Enable robots.txt. When false, all agents are disallowed.

RobotsAddToDefault.description: Append RobotsEntries to the default rules instead of replacing them.

LlmsEnabled.description: Register the /llms.txt route and serve content. When false, the route is not registered.

DefaultTitle.description: H1 title rendered at the top of llms.txt.

DefaultFilePath.description: Path to a .md or .json file to serve when no domain match is found. Relative paths resolve from ContentRootPath.

Configurations.description: Per-domain site configurations matched by request host.

Domain.description: Hostname to match against the request (e.g. example.com).

FilePath.description: Path to a .md or .json file to serve for this domain. Relative paths resolve from ContentRootPath. When set, inline Name/Summary/Sections are ignored.

Name.description: Site name rendered as a section heading. Used when FilePath is not set.

Summary.description: Short description rendered as a blockquote.

AdditionalNotes.description: Free-form notes appended after the summary.

Sections.description: Link sections rendered as markdown list items.

Description.description: Optional description appended after the link.
